name: suppressor of cytokine signaling 1

function.text: SOCS1 encodes suppressor of cytokine signaling 1. Annotated molecular activities include kinase inhibitor activity and protein kinase inhibitor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and macrophage differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autoinflammatory syndrome with immunodeficiency (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Classic Hodgkin lymphoma; Mediastinal gray zone lymphoma; Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
